action.command: cd /tmp && rm -f cj.txt && echo "---GET signin for CSRF---" && curl -s -c cj.txt http://localhost:3000/users/sign-in -o s.html && TOKEN=$(grep -oE 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]+"' s.html | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//') && echo "token_len=${#TOKEN}" && echo "---POST login---" && curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -o login_resp.html -w "code=%{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3000/users/sign-in --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" --data-urlencode "user[email]=admin@example.org" --data-urlencode "user[password]=UxbuS7Zp8BNM" && echo "---follow-up authenticated request---" && curl -s -b cj.txt -o after.html -w "code=%{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n" http://localhost:3000/ && grep -oE "<title>[^<]*</title>" after.html
